name: Claude chatbot over Garmin InReach on Cloudflare Worker

mentions.name: Claude chatbot over Garmin InReach on Cloudflare Worker
mentions.description: A Cloudflare Worker that wires Twilio to the Anthropic API so the user can chat with Claude over a Garmin InReach satellite messenger during a 3-week backcountry trip to Alaska's North Slope. Location metadata is included in the system prompt for accurate location-based info such as weather and hunting regulations, and access to Garmin's professional-plan inReach Portal Connect inbound/outbound APIs is pending.
mentions.source_excerpt: Wired up Twilio & Anthropic API on a Cloudflare Worker so I can chat with Claude via Garmin InReach during a 3-week backcountry trip to Alaska's North Slope. Location metadata is included in the system prompt for accurate location-based info (weather, hunting regs, etc).
mentions.author: tomchuk
